title.en: A Tunnel map of the printed Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine line
title.zh: 用《隧道》给已印的柴油混凝土喷涂机画一张目录

description.en: Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine is restated under Tunnel. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Diesel Concrete Spraying Machine. The published table prints Power Type Diesel engine; Engine Power 28/32 HP; Output Capacity 5 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 8 MPa; Delivery Distance (H / V) 80 m / 40 m; Hose Diameter 38/51 mm; Max. Particle Size ≤6 mm; Sand-Cement Ratio ≤1:3; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2350 × 750 × 1050 mm; Main Unit Weight 480 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 柴油混凝土喷涂机放在《隧道》的结构下重述。邢台河北品锦机械公布柴油混凝土喷涂机。已公布参数表印有：动力形式柴油机；发动机功率28/32 HP；理论输送量5 m³/h；最大出口压力8 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直）80 m / 40 m；管径38/51 mm；最大粒径≤6 mm；砂灰比≤1:3；外形尺寸2350 × 750 × 1050 mm；整机重量480 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
